rules.title: ARR activity and forested-land eligibility
rules.logic: Projects may establish, increase, or restore vegetative cover in non-forest areas. Area-based projects may also enhance stocks in existing forest cover only where the forest has not been managed for wood products in the previous ten years.

rules.title: Area-based leakage module requirement
rules.logic: Projects using the area-based approach must apply VMD0054 to account for leakage related to displacement of pre-project agricultural activities.

rules.title: Approach applicability is mutually exclusive by instance
rules.logic: Each project activity instance must satisfy either the area-based or census-based applicability conditions. Different approaches may be used within one project only for clearly separated, non-overlapping instances.

rules.title: Quantification approach fixed for crediting period
rules.logic: For enrolled land, the quantification approach is selected at project start and used for the entire project crediting period.

rules.title: Project start date trigger
rules.logic: The project start date is the earliest of the beginning of site preparation activities or the land-use-change date.

rules.title: Area-based t0 carbon-stock estimate
rules.logic: Area-based projects must establish a t=0 estimate for all significant carbon pools. Remote-sensing estimates may be used for pre-existing woody biomass only under the conditions in Section 4.2 and Section 8.2.1.2.

rules.title: Area-based leakage cannot be assumed de minimis
rules.logic: Area-based projects must monitor and quantify leakage using VMD0054; leakage may not be assumed de minimis.

rules.title: Census-based direct planting and land-use continuity
rules.logic: Census-based projects must use direct planting and maintain the pre-project land use throughout the project lifetime.

rules.title: Census-based planting density limit
rules.logic: Planting density must not exceed 50 planting units per hectare, with the limit scaled proportionally for instances smaller than or including partial hectares.

rules.title: Complete census establishes N and t0
rules.logic: A complete census of project planting units establishes N and t=0. Existing vegetation is excluded from N and from the planting-density threshold.

rules.title: Planting-unit identification
rules.logic: Each planting unit must be field-identifiable using either GPS coordinates that respect positional-accuracy spacing or a durable physical marker with a unique identifier.

rules.title: Census-based pre-existing cover and land-use eligibility
rules.logic: The census-based activity must occur in an area with less than 10% pre-existing woody biomass cover and/or in qualifying continuous-cropping, settlement, or other-land circumstances described by Section 4.3.

rules.title: Project-related soil-disturbance restrictions
rules.logic: Project-related soil disturbance is allowed at planting under Section 4.3 conditions; soil inversion associated with planting must not exceed 25 cm and may occur only once during the project crediting period.
